scope: Fresh text generation for three A1 lessons in reading and listening modes. Listening samples contain scripts only; no audio was generated in these checks.
inclusion_policy: Append each fresh batch, retain all its emitted samples and report every planned call. Do not replace earlier failures with later successes or omit rejected responses.

hash_notes.request_sha256: Canonical JSON hash of the complete synthetic frozen request.
hash_notes.schema_sha256: Canonical JSON hash of the provider response schema selected for this sample.
hash_notes.frozen_generation_prompt_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact frozen system-prompt text.
hash_notes.frozen_generation_schema_sha256: Schema hash saved inside the frozen request.
hash_notes.system_messages_sha256: Canonical JSON hash of the actual system/developer messages sent.
hash_notes.provider_request_sha256: Canonical JSON hash of the actual provider request; its body is intentionally omitted here.
hash_notes.raw_response_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact returned assistant text before JSON parsing. generated_response preserves its parsed synthetic content.
hash_notes.generator_sha256: SHA-256 of the generator source file used for the batch.
hash_notes.accepted_document_sha256: Frozen accepted-document content hash; null when validation rejected the response.
hash_notes.frozen_generation_input_sha256: Canonical JSON hash of the compact frozen writer brief used as the provider input for source-v3 and later revisions.

review_method.method: Read each complete generated passage, questions, choices and explanations against the intended lesson and cited evidence.
review_method.limitation: An assistant review of synthetic smoke samples is not independent language review, semantic validation or exam calibration. Structural acceptance alone does not establish pedagogical quality.

batches.purpose: Initial bounded generation check before further reliability changes.

structural_validation.reason: The answer must match its planned fact and exact source evidence.

findings.question: q2
findings.detail: The passage names two later destinations: the pharmacy and then the park. «Куда потом идёт Олег?» does not specify which later stop is being asked about. The park is offered as a distractor even though Oleg also goes there.

findings.detail: The cited sentence contains «Он», not «Олег». The answer requires the preceding sentence to identify him. This explains the exact-source rejection; it is not evidence that the Russian answer itself is false.
The repeated statement that Oleg is still at the library adds little. The sequence moves to his later destinations, then back to finding him now, then forward again.

findings.detail: A future arrival and week-long stay are followed by departure to Moscow, then «В этот день я жду тебя в гостинице». It is unclear whether this refers to arrival day or departure day. The following present-tense reading and resting are not clearly connected to the future plan.

findings.question: q2
findings.detail: «О чём она думает?» does not name its referent. The full recording mentions the mother and Anna; a standalone question should identify the mother rather than rely on an unstated reference to one source sentence.
A dense series of topics, speakers, negation and topic/location contrasts makes the recording function like a grammar demonstration rather than a clear beginner voice message.

findings.question: q3
findings.detail: The validator rejects «о книге» because it appears in the same evidence sentence as «о музыке». The sentence explicitly assigns the book to the speaker and music to Anna. For «О чём Анна рассказывает?» these are different actors, so mention of the distractor is not itself an ambiguity. This does not remove the other language-review concerns.
